basic_details.job_title: TNSRLM Mayiladuthurai District Resource Person Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Tamil Nadu State Rural Livelihoods Mission Mayiladuthurai (TNSRLM Mayiladuthurai) has notified vacancies for the District Resource Person post on a contract basis under its 2026 recruitment, with applications sent directly or by registered post to the District Collectorate, 4th Floor, District Management Unit, Tamil Nadu State Rural Livelihoods Mission on or before 23 October 2026. Candidates must hold a B.Sc. Agriculture, B.Sc. Horticulture, B.V.Sc, B.Sc. (Forestry) or B.F.Sc. qualification, along with a minimum of 3 years experience in government schemes, NGOs, private, FPOs or related techn

qualification.details: Educational Qualification: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. Agriculture, B.Sc. Horticulture, B.V.Sc, B.Sc. (Forestry), or B.F.Sc. degree from recognized Universities. | Experience: A minimum of 3 years of work experience in government schemes, government-aided organizations, private sectors, farmers' producer organizations (FPOs), or other related technical departments. | Age Limit: Minimum 27 years and maximum 65 years. Candidates above 65 years of age will not be considered for selection.

selection_process: The selection of candidates is carried out through an outsourcing mechanism or direct recruitment method based on the verification of submitted application forms and fulfillment of the specified eligibility criteria.

content_sections.heading: TNSRLM Mayiladuthurai District Resource Person at a Glance

rows.details: Tamil Nadu State Rural Livelihoods Mission, Mayiladuthurai
District Resource Person (District Resource Person / District Resource Person (Pannai) / Regional Project)
B.Sc. Agriculture / B.Sc. Horticulture / B.V.Sc / B.Sc. (Forestry) / B.F.Sc. from recognized Universities

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted in the prescribed format and addressed to the District Collectorate, 4th Floor, District Management Unit, Mayiladuthurai. Candidates can submit their applications either in person or through registered post so that they reach the designated office on or before the stipulated deadline.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. Agriculture, B.Sc. Horticulture, B.V.Sc, B.Sc. (Forestry), or B.F.Sc. degree from recognized Universities. Experience: A minimum of 3 years of work experience in government schemes, government-aided organizations, private sectors, farmers' producer organizations (FPOs), or other related technical departments. Age Limit: Minimum 27 years and maximum 65 years. Candidates above 65 years of age will not be considered for selection.

rows.post: District Resource Person (District Resource Person / Pannai)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection of candidates is carried out through an outsourcing mechanism or direct recruitment method based on the verification of submitted application forms and fulfillment of the specified eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for TNSRLM Mayiladuthurai District Resource Person Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 23 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the District Resource Person post?
faq.answer: The exact number of vacancies is not stated in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a B.Sc. Agriculture, B.Sc. Horticulture, B.V.Sc, B.Sc. (Forestry), or B.F.Sc. degree from recognized universities.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 27 years and the maximum age limit is 65 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary offered for the District Resource Person?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 45,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. How should applications be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted either in person or through registered post to the District Collectorate, 4th Floor, District Management Unit, Mayiladuthurai.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates below 27 years of age, above 65 years of age, or those lacking the specified degree and required 3 years of experience cannot apply.
